metadata.title: NUnit Testing - Sources
metadata.description: Current official sources for NUnit fixture design, .NET test runner modes, ASP.NET Core integration testing, Testcontainers, WireMock.Net, and package-level compatibility checks.

official_documentation.name: .NET testing overview
official_documentation.description: Current entry point for .NET testing guidance and framework-specific tutorials.

official_documentation.name: NUnit runner introduction (MTP)
official_documentation.description: Current Microsoft guidance for creating and running NUnit tests with Microsoft.Testing.Platform.

official_documentation.name: dotnet test command
official_documentation.description: Current CLI reference for test execution, artifacts path, and logging behavior.

official_documentation.name: Testing with dotnet test (VSTest and MTP modes)
official_documentation.description: VSTest is the default dotnet test mode; Microsoft.Testing.Platform (MTP) is opt-in. Check the installed SDK's documentation for supported runner selectors, their precedence, and current CLI syntax before changing test commands.

official_documentation.name: ASP.NET Core integration tests
official_documentation.description: Current guidance for WebApplicationFactory-based integration testing.

official_documentation.name: .NET code coverage
official_documentation.description: Coverage collection guidance and current tool references.

official_documentation.name: MTP code coverage extensions
official_documentation.description: Coverage under Microsoft.Testing.Platform: coverlet.MTP and Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage. coverlet.collector and coverlet.msbuild cannot be used with MTP. IncludeTestAssembly defaults to false in Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage (was true in VSTest).

nunit_docs.name: NUnit framework release notes
nunit_docs.description: NUnit release history. Check the current stable release and migration notes before recommending a version or adapting async asserts, delegate types, and platform names.

nunit_docs.name: NUnit 4 migration guide
nunit_docs.description: Breaking changes from NUnit 3.x to 4.x: classic asserts moved from NUnit.Framework.Assert to NUnit.Framework.Legacy.ClassicAssert (call-syntax restored in 4.5 via C# 14 extension methods), delegate type changes, minimum TFM increase.

nunit_docs.name: NUnit and Microsoft.Testing.Platform
nunit_docs.description: How to enable MTP in NUnit projects using EnableNUnitRunner. Adapter version compatibility: 5.x for MTP 1.x, 6.x for MTP 2.0.

nunit_docs.name: NUnit3TestAdapter adapter release notes
nunit_docs.description: Adapter version history. Check the current release and its MTP and target-framework compatibility before pinning.

nunit_docs.name: FixtureLifeCycle
nunit_docs.description: Lifecycle semantics for instance-per-test-case fixtures and one-time setup constraints.

nunit_docs.name: Parallelizable
nunit_docs.description: Parallel execution scopes and cautions for shared state.

nunit_docs.name: Multiple asserts
nunit_docs.description: Current guidance for grouped assertions with Assert.Multiple and Assert.EnterMultipleScope.

nunit_docs.name: TestContext
nunit_docs.description: Current NUnit diagnostics surface including progress and output streams.

nunit_docs.name: Retry attribute
nunit_docs.description: Current semantics for retrying tests and its limitations.

runner_and_platform.name: Microsoft.Testing.Platform introduction
runner_and_platform.description: Current overview of Microsoft.Testing.Platform and its compatibility model. All major frameworks (NUnit, xUnit, MSTest) now ship MTP runners.

runner_and_platform.name: Microsoft.Testing.Platform via dotnet test (VSTest mode, legacy for MTP)
runner_and_platform.description: Running MTP projects under the VSTest mode of dotnet test. Requires TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport=true. Considered legacy as of .NET 10 SDK in favor of MTP mode via global.json.

runner_and_platform.name: global.json overview
runner_and_platform.description: SDK pinning and test runner selection reference. Use test.runner: Microsoft.Testing.Platform in global.json to opt in to MTP mode with .NET 10 SDK.

assertion_libraries.name: FluentAssertions license change (v8)
assertion_libraries.description: FluentAssertions under the Xceed Community License is free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a subscription. The preceding Apache-2.0 line remains open source. Check which license covers the selected package and use the publisher's pricing page for costs.

assertion_libraries.name: AwesomeAssertions NuGet
assertion_libraries.description: AwesomeAssertions is an Apache-2.0 community fork of FluentAssertions. Migration is mainly a namespace rename from FluentAssertions to AwesomeAssertions; check migration notes for additional API differences before upgrading.

assertion_libraries.name: Shouldly NuGet
assertion_libraries.description: Free, BSD-3 fluent assertion library (ShouldBe-style API; no .Should() entry point). Recommended alternative to FluentAssertions for new repos.

assertion_libraries.name: FluentResults.Extensions.AwesomeAssertions NuGet
assertion_libraries.description: AwesomeAssertions extensions for FluentResults Result types; required for fluent result.Should() assertions on FluentResults (1.0.0).

containers_and_doubles.name: Testcontainers best practices
containers_and_doubles.description: Container best practices: pin image versions, use random host ports, avoid host-path mounts (use WithResourceMapping), and avoid fixed names. Check the current package release before pinning.

containers_and_doubles.name: Testcontainers wait strategies
containers_and_doubles.description: Current readiness probes and waiting primitives for deterministic startup.

containers_and_doubles.name: WireMock.Net
containers_and_doubles.description: Official WireMock.Net entry point for stubbing, verification, and scenario control.

package_references.name: NUnit package
package_references.description: Package metadata. Check the current stable release, prerelease status, and supported target frameworks before pinning.

package_references.name: NUnit.Analyzers package
package_references.description: Analyzer package metadata. Check the current release and available async-assert rules before pinning.

package_references.name: NUnit3TestAdapter package
package_references.description: Adapter package metadata. Check the current release, target-framework floor, and supported MTP generation before pinning.

package_references.name: coverlet.MTP package
package_references.description: Native Coverlet integration for Microsoft.Testing.Platform. Required when using MTP mode — coverlet.collector and coverlet.msbuild are VSTest-only and will not collect coverage under MTP. Check NuGet for the current version and its Microsoft.Testing.Platform floor.

package_references.name: Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage package
package_references.description: Microsoft's coverage extension for MTP. Check its current release, supported coverage switches, and MTP dependency floor before pinning.

package_references.name: MediatR package
package_references.description: Used by the handler templates. 12.5.0 was Apache-2.0; 13.0.0+ ship a custom licence file instead of an SPDX expression. Commercial terms unsourced — verify before adopting in a commercial repo.
